title: Grand Theft Auto 2/Codes
text:
Each cheat code is activated by editing player name to change it to the code. However, on Windows first enter GOURANGA as player name, then edit it to enter the code: once all codes wanted have been entered, player name can be changed back again so that any High  is attributed to it.

Any codes entered can be active when you start play in an area, but if you resume saved status then the following can be unaffected:

 Respect
 Bonus Multiplier
 Lives
 ../Weapons/

However, on Windows:

 MUCHCASH and SEGARULZ cannot be activated at the same time: only the last entered is activated.
 DANISGOD cannot be active with IAMDAVEJ.
 MUCHCASH can be active with DANISGOD ($700,000 in total) or IAMDAVEJ ($10,499,999), but only if entered after either or both.
 NEKKID and BUCKFAST cannot be active with LASVEGAS.

Save status, and any codes entered for that player should remain active whenever you resume with that player, until you quit the game itself. However, whenever you reopen the game to play and resume saved status, only codes affecting that normally saved remain:

 Areas and ../Bonus Stages/
 Respect
  and Bonus Multiplier
 Lives
 Weapons

Everything else is no longer active.

 Debug mode
